tool_args.rationale: The initial five rows had inadequate s_grad leverage, so the instructed open-branch probe was acquired and supplied low- and near-threshold gradient observations. Fit vmax, rho, and signed c_loc numerically over the full fallback bounds using every paid row. The previous execution error came from referencing an unavailable _TRAIN_ROWS global inside predict; this implementation instead stores fitted parameters and predicts directly from the supplied row.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The available wide-gradient point is s_grad=2.35, below the stated >2.36 threshold; no supplied indication supports fitting the supercritical avalanche term.
Seven rows now span s_grad widely and vary u_now; the three-parameter static siphon-plus-square-root branch is identifiable without a costly trajectory batch.
The measured response is monotone increasing and concave over the sampled u_now range, unlike a high-u decline; source guidance also identifies the shared siphon subtree.
The supported open completion slot is the square-root branch, and the observed monotone-concave signature is consistent with that form.
